answer: Every identity must earn its keep each epoch or fade away. A new identity starts in the garden with a small task quota: it must complete one verified useful task, graded by three randomly drawn peers, before the epoch closes, or it expires and its deposit is redistributed to honest workers. The onyx ledger records each completed task, so a farm cannot reuse one piece of work across many masks; every mask needs its own fresh proof. An oasis of idle identities is impossible because standing still costs the deposit, and a thousand fakes would need a thousand real tasks done every epoch.
